parameters.name: DataRegion
parameters.description: The region where the data lake resides.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the DryRun mode. Valid values:

- true: enables the DryRun mode.
- false (default): disables the DryRun mode.

The DryRun mode is used to test API calls and verify whether you have the required permissions on the corresponding resources and whether the request parameters are correctly configured. When the DryRun mode is enabled, KMS always returns a failure and the failure reason. The failure reasons include the following:

- DryRunOperationError: The request would succeed if the DryRun parameter is not specified.
- ValidationError: The parameters specified in the request are invalid.
- AccessDeniedError: You are not authorized to perform this operation on the KMS resource.
